header.running_head: The Chapter Concerning Da'wah Towards Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ

They then looked for Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Affaan (RA) and Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Auf (RA) who knew them and eventually found them sitting with a group of Muhaajireen and Ansaar. They said, "O Uthmaan! O Abdur Rahmaan! Your Nabi wrote a letter to us and we have arrived in response to the letter. However, when we came to him and greeted him, he did not reply to our greeting and although we searched all day for an opportunity to speak to him, we have been unable to do so. What is your opinion? Do you think that we should return?"
Hadhrat Ali bin Abi Taalib (RA) was also in the gathering, so the two of them asked him, "What do you think of these people, O Abul Hasan?" Addressing Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) and Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Auf (RA), Hadhrat Ali (RA) said, "I think that they should remove these clothes and these rings and wear their traveling clothes. Thereafter they should return to Rasulullaah ﷺ. When they did this and again greeted Rasulullaah ﷺ, he replied to their greeting and said, "I swear by the Being Who has sent me with the truth that Iblees was certainly with you when you came to me the first time." Rasulullaah ﷺ then asked about them and they asked him questions. During the course of their questioning, they asked, "What have you to say about Isa (AS)? We are Christians and will be returning to our people. If you are a Nabi, we would be pleased to hear what you have to say about him."
Rasulullaah ﷺ said to them, "I have nothing much to say about him today. Stay a while longer until I am able to inform you what my Rabb has to say about Isa (AS)." By the following morning, the following verses of the Qur'aan had been revealed:

blocks.arabic_text: اِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيْسٰى عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ كَمَثَلِ اٰدَمَ خَلَقَهٗ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهٗ كُنْ فَيَكُوْنُ ۝ اَلْحَقُّ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُنْ مِّنَ الْمُمْتَرِيْنَ ۝ فَمَنْ حَآجَّكَ فِيْهِ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ فَقُلْ تَعَالَوْا نَدْعُ اَبْنَآءَنَا وَاَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَنِسَآءَنَا وَنِسَآءَكُمْ وَاَنْفُسَنَا وَاَنْفُسَكُمْ ثُمَّ نَبْتَهِلْ فَنَجْعَلْ لَّعْنَتَ اللّٰهِ عَلَى الْكٰذِبِيْنَ ۝
blocks.text: Verily the likeness of Isa (AS) (who was created without a father) with Allaah is as the likeness of Aadam (AS) (who was created with neither a father nor a mother). He (Allaah) created him (Aadam (AS)) from clay then said to him, "Be!" and he became (a living man). This is the truth from your Rabb so do not be of those who doubt. Whoever disputes with you (O Muhammad ﷺ) concerning this (concerning the incident of Isa (AS)) after the knowledge (revelation) has come to you, then say to them, "Come!
